lesson: Do not merge new capability parameters into an already-authorized experiment whose parameter lineage is hard-locked. Preserve the ratified module exactly and add the next capability as an independently governed sidecar when that also improves modularity.
reusable_rule: Before extending a trained or authorized module, inspect launchers/trainers for exact architecture or hash assumptions. If extension would invalidate lineage, separate the capability rather than silently revising the experiment.
anti_pattern: Architectural enthusiasm that changes a pending experiment underneath its ratified config.

lesson: Stored graph direction and semantic relation symmetry are distinct concerns. Memory Core canonicalizes conflicts to one stored edge, while the model must mirror conflict messages so behavior is orientation-independent.
reusable_rule: Encode storage conventions explicitly at the model boundary; never assume a canonicalized storage edge has directional semantics.

lesson: Query-conditioned pooling can change which cached structured evidence matters without re-encoding all fields. This preserves the fast-path rule while adding relation-aware reasoning.
reusable_rule: Prefer cheap query-conditioned reads over repeated upstream encoding when stable field representations can be cached.
